_comment: The endless dungeon (Phase 5). Floors are generated from these TIERS (2026-08-26: one per floor 1-20, the designer's monster-by-level list; floors 21+ reuse floor 20's) — each covers a span of floor depths and says what spawns there. 'styles': 'rooms' (halls and corridors) or 'caves' (twisting caverns; caves have no doors). 'monsters': id -> weight (higher = more common; ids from monsters.json). 'monster_count'/'chest_count'/'trap_count'/'secret_doors': dice strings rolled per floor. 'traps': which trap ids (from 'traps' below) this tier uses. 'rest_ambush': camp-attack chance. Floors deeper than the last tier keep using it. TRAPS: 'dice' damage, 'save' ability + 'dc' for half, optional 'condition' on a failed save. The BOSS floor is hand-drawn here — same format as a level file — and unlocks when every hero is level 20. Edit freely! 'chest_trap_chance': chance (0-1) any chest is rigged (a tier may override it; the trap is drawn from that tier's 'traps' list). 'vault_loot': what makes a secret vault's chest (*) rich — gold_multiplier scales the tier's chest_gold roll, gear_pieces = how many pieces of real gear it holds, drawn from the floor's item TIER band (depth 1-4 draws tier 1, 5-8 tier 2, 9-12 tier 3, 13-16 tier 4, 17+ tier 5; an empty tier falls back down). 'search_turns': how many map turns a deliberate Space-search costs — it always finds every adjacent hidden thing (if anyone in the party has any detect skill), but monsters keep moving and poison keeps ticking while you comb the walls. 'scroll_drops' (magic v3, 2026-08-28): scrolls in chests by floor band — 'chance' = odds a regular chest ($) holds ONE scroll, 'levels' = which spell levels it may be, 'rare_chance' = of those, the share that are rare lore; 'vault' = the same knobs for a secret vault's chest (*), rolled IN ADDITION to the vault's gear. A scroll never drops for a spell with no scroll item (rare pools fall back to common, and vice versa). These odds are the lethality dial — proposals, tune freely. | BALANCE PASS 2026-09-04 (designer: 'the loot is too rich'): chest_item_cap 2 (a chest keeps at most two of its rolled items besides gold and a scroll), floors 5+ chest_gold cut ~35%, potion chances ×0.7, scroll chances halved (vault scroll chance ×0.6, rares halved). All numbers proposals.

_encounters_comment: ENCOUNTERS (designer ruling 2026-08-31: fights should be ENCOUNTERS, not lone monsters — 'a vampire with a wight and a shadow under its command'). A tier with an 'encounters' list spawns encounter_count (dice) GROUPS per floor instead of scattered singles: each entry {weight, name (optional, spoken in the battle-start line when the group fights together), group: [monster ids or {id, count: dice}]} — a group of one is the deliberate lone terror. Groups may reach OUTSIDE the tier's roster for thematic retinues (a floor-16 death knight leads floor-8 wights). Members spawn CLUSTERED (within 2 tiles) so the battle radius pulls the whole court in. The old 'monsters'+'monster_count' fields remain as the fallback (and feed camp-ambush legends). All groups and weights are CONTENT PROPOSALS — recompose freely.
